items.title: Importance of Teamwork and Communication in Digital Environments

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Importance of Teamwork and Communication in Digital Environments under 9.3 as printed (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Teamwork in digital environments requires clear communication and trust among team members. When everyone contributes ideas and listens to others, projects run smoothly. Effective communication prevents misunderstandings and ensures that all members stay informed about progress. Tools like group chats, emails, and video calls help teams stay connected. Good teamwork encourages creativity, cooperation, and shared responsibility in achieving goals.
